mechanism: The great displacement is ancient: the upper channel has been fully displaced (B pinned at -1.000) since mid-2021 and price has sat on the 3-7 shelf for four years, far below the 40.62 peak but well above its life lows. The last month's damage is sparse and self-healing - three isolated channel deaths (07-28, 08-05, 08-17) each zeroed URF for one reading and re-knit within a session, with S_UF snapping back to 0.87-0.88 while price stayed flat in a 5.2-5.6 band. At the edge the field leans up: positive-displacement readings dominate the final week and direction held +1 for eight consecutive readings into the 08-19 close with residual resistance stable near 0.58 - a re-knitting base, not fresh structural damage, so there is nothing for a short to feed on.
